name: flarepanel-api
description: FlarePanel API: tracking, the dashboard API, sign-in and background jobs.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

API_URL.description: This Worker’s address: https://flarepanel-api.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev. Your workers.dev subdomain is under Workers & Pages → Settings in the Cloudflare dashboard.

DASHBOARD_URL.description: The dashboard Worker’s address: https://flarepanel-dashboard.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev. Deploy it with the second button.

CUSTOM_COOKIE_DOMAIN.description: Your workers.dev subdomain, for example `your-subdomain.workers.dev`, so the sign-in cookie reaches both Workers.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A third random string (`openssl rand -hex 32`). Keep a copy: stored AI and integration keys cannot be read without it.

EVENTS_ARCHIVE.description: Raw event archive, imports, replays and AI prompt text.
